item.title: Issues and Use of Rare Earth Elements in Energy Transition
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on the challenges and applications of rare earth elements within the context of energy transition. The call invites research exploring the various dimensions of rare earth element utilization as societies shift toward sustainable energy systems.

Appel publié par Resources Policy. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
